section_summary.extract_value: This section (4.2.3-4.2.4) reports results from a 2×2 ANCOVA examining the effects of guilt and appearance/health manipulations on post-test state body anxiety (PASTAS), and mediation analyses testing whether post-test guilt mediates the relationship between the guilt manipulation and body anxiety. Results show that trait body anxiety strongly predicted state body anxiety, the guilt manipulation significantly increased post-test guilt, and guilt served as a significant indirect pathway (TNIE) to body anxiety for women in the guilt condition only, with no mediation effect in the no-guilt condition.
